remarks: Welcome to Fillow Ridge - Your Perfect Norwalk Retreat. First time on the market since 1990.   Discover this immaculate 1BR/1BA condo offering nearly 800 sq ft of air-conditioned living in Norwalk's highly desirable Fillow Ridge complex. Enjoy your private deck overlooking a beautifully treed yard.  Key Updates: * Brand new windows (July 2025) * New water heater (Dec 2024) * Samsung electric range (Nov 2021) * In-unit washer/dryer (Oct 2021) * Complete kitchen appliances (2015) * Updated HVAC & ductwork  Community Excellence: Low monthly HOA in a meticulously maintained complex that reflects pride of ownership throughout.  This move-in ready home combines modern updates with outdoor tranquility and affordable luxury living in one of Norwalk's most sought-after neighborhoods.  Schedule your private showing with me and experience the Fillow Ridge lifestyle. Located by Oak Hills Golf Club
